text_block_list.text:
—In front of the stairs, Mejiro Ryan was 
trembling and shivering slightly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... T-Trainer...! I put on way too much 
weight on the leg press yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A-As you can see, I'm sore all over, 
but... Please don't worry...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This is just proof that my muscles are 
growing!
choice_data_list: Are you feeling up for today's training?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No problem at all! See, just like this—

Perhaps due to muscle soreness, Mejiro 
Ryan wasn't at her best during training.
